title: Customer Support Email Classification & Auto-Response System
description:
Support teams receive hundreds of emails a day across billing, technical and sales topics. Sorting them by hand delays the first response and sends emails to the wrong team. The goal is a system that classifies each incoming email by urgency, department and intent, prepares a reply draft for routine questions, and hands complex or urgent cases to a person.

Requirements

  • Handle around 500 support emails per day for several departments.
  • Recognize common requests: billing questions, technical issues, refund requests, product information.
  • Extract key details such as order numbers, account IDs and error codes.
  • Produce reply drafts that agents can edit, in the company's tone and based on its policies.
  • Work with an existing ticket system such as Zendesk or Freshdesk.
  • Support English, Spanish and German.

Challenges

  • Emails vary a lot in format, tone and technical detail.
  • Urgent issues (outages, failed payments) must be separated from routine requests.
  • Replies must not promise anything the policies do not cover.
  • The system should improve from agent corrections over time.
goals:
• Classification accuracy of 85 % or more on a labeled sample of your own emails before emails are routed automatically.
  • First response for standard inquiries within 30 minutes instead of about 4 hours.
  • Every urgent or low-confidence email is flagged for a person; no reply reaches a customer without review.
  • Order numbers, account IDs and error codes are extracted into the ticket for every email that contains them.
